home.proofRange: Europe’s largest thermal transfer ribbon range
home.proofStock: Hundreds of sizes in stock for next-day delivery
home.proofColour: Infinite colour possibilities, made to order in five days

advantage.title: Advantage Range | Todaytec Group Europe
advantage.description: The Advantage Range covers around 95% of thermal transfer applications with wax, wax resin and resin grades, 400 stock sizes and next-day delivery across Europe.
advantage.headline: Ninety-five percent of applications, in one compact range.
advantage.intro: The Advantage Range of thermal transfer ribbons has been selected for quality, reliability, value and its ability to cover a wide range of applications.
advantage.point1: Wax, wax/resin and resin grades for all printer types
advantage.point2: 400 sizes available from stock for next-day delivery
advantage.point3: Ideal for paper and synthetic industrial labels, desktop printers, in-line coding, or print-and-apply
advantage.waxPitchTitle: Do you really need wax resin?
advantage.waxPitchBody: Our enhanced wax ribbon gives the protection short-term labels need — at a great price.
advantage.resinPitchTitle: Twice the durability of typical resin ribbons
advantage.resinPitchBody: TDR345 outperforms with twice the scratch resistance and superb chemical resistance.
advantage.oemBody: Advantage ribbons perform as well as, or even better than, OEM ribbons. Switch with confidence.
advantage.uniqueBody: We don’t just supply ribbons — we engineer them. Our team can develop ribbons for any application, in any width, any length and any colour.

grades.customTitle: Cannot find the size you need?
grades.customBody: Custom-made items are produced individually. Standard production time is usually 1 to 2 weeks. Allow a quantity tolerance of ±10% on orders of around 100 rolls.
grades.branding: Design your own datasheets and box-end labels

tdw108.title: TDW108 Premium Flat Head Wax | Todaytec Group Europe
tdw108.description: TDW108 is a premium flat-head wax ribbon for outstanding print on plain and coated papers, with ISEGA food-contact approval and low printhead energy.
tdw108.name: Premium Flat Head Wax
tdw108.summary: A premium wax ribbon designed for outstanding print performance on plain and coated papers, where price is the main factor.
tdw108.body: TDW108 offers a black, crisp and bold print for standard applications that need a low level of image durability. Low printhead energy makes it a drop-in replacement for other waxes, with print speeds up to 8 inches per second. It is ISEGA approved for use when the printed image contacts dry, moist and fatty foodstuffs.

tdw136.title: TDW136 High Performance Flat Head Wax | Todaytec Group Europe
tdw136.description: TDW136 is a resin-enhanced flat-head wax ribbon for uncoated paper to mid-range synthetics, RFID labels and freeze applications down to -26°C.
tdw136.name: High Performance Flat Head Wax
tdw136.summary: A high-performance resin-enhanced wax for a wide range of applications, from uncoated paper to synthetic label stock.
tdw136.body: The special ink formulation and unique back coating produce an excellent antistatic ribbon, ideal for RFID labels and for extending printhead life. It prints dark, durable images with crisp rotated barcodes at up to 8 inches per second, and can withstand freezing temperatures down to -26°C.

tdm200.title: TDM200 Premium Flat Head Wax Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdm200.description: TDM200 is a premium all-round flat-head wax resin ribbon for dark, durable barcodes on paper and synthetic labels, including flood-coated stocks.
tdm200.name: Premium Flat Head Wax Resin
tdm200.summary: An excellent all-round premium wax resin for dark, crisp images on a wide range of paper and synthetic labels.
tdm200.body: Developed for the widest possible range of pre-printed labels, TDM200 performs on spot and flood coatings without extra thermal-transfer varnish. An antistatic backcoat and unique ink formulation print on paper and synthetics, and the grade meets ANSI Standard A for scratch and smudge resistance.

tdm242.title: TDM242 High Performance Flat Head Wax Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdm242.description: TDM242 is a high-performance flat-head wax resin and a proven replacement for Ricoh B110A, with high durability at low print energy.
tdm242.name: High Performance Flat Head Wax Resin
tdm242.summary: One of the best-performing flat-head wax resin grades, with the durability expected of a premium product.
tdm242.body: TDM242 covers the widest range of synthetic materials and coated papers, printing at low energy for higher speeds. It has been used very successfully as a replacement for the world’s leading wax resin grade, Ricoh B110A.

tdm665.title: TDM665 Premium Near Edge Wax Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdm665.description: TDM665 is a premium near-edge wax resin for tray-end cards, uncoated papers and food packaging, printing at up to 16 inches per second.
tdm665.name: Premium Near Edge Wax Resin
tdm665.summary: An all-round high-performance near-edge wax resin with a slightly lower resin content for better print on vellum and uncoated papers.
tdm665.body: TDM665 is ideally suited to tray-end card applications using Toshiba near-edge printers in the fresh-produce packing industry. It offers bold black prints at up to 16 inches per second and is a proven drop-in replacement for OEM products from Toshiba TEC, Avery, Markem, Videojet and ICE.

tdm680.title: TDM680 High Performance Near Edge Wax Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdm680.description: TDM680 is a high-performance near-edge wax resin for TTO coding and packaging films, printing at up to 24 inches per second with ISEGA approval.
tdm680.name: High Performance Near Edge Wax Resin
tdm680.summary: The most flexible near-edge wax resin for desktop, industrial and in-line coding printers.
tdm680.body: TDM680 offers maximum print performance on coated or uncoated labels, packaging films and medical paper. With ISEGA approval it is the ideal choice for in-line coders used in food packaging, printing bold black images at up to 24 inches per second.

tdm680x.title: TDM680X Near Edge Wax Resin — longer rolls | Todaytec Group Europe
tdm680x.description: TDM680X matches TDM680 performance on thinner film for longer ribbon rolls, fewer changeovers and high-speed TTO coding.
tdm680x.name: High Performance Near Edge Wax Resin — longer rolls
tdm680x.summary: The same performance as TDM680, coated on thinner PET film for longer ribbon lengths.
tdm680x.body: TDM680X reduces ribbon changes on high-volume lines while retaining high-speed print, packaging-film compatibility and ISEGA food-packaging approval. Print speeds up to 20 inches per second.

tdr345.title: TDR345 Premium Flat Head Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdr345.description: TDR345 is a super high-performance flat-head resin with steam, chemical and heat resistance up to 300°C. Halogen-free and UL/CSA approved.
tdr345.name: Premium Flat Head Resin
tdr345.summary: A super high-performance resin using innovative ink technology across the widest range of receiver materials.
tdr345.body: Traditionally, maximum-durability jobs needed several resin grades. TDR345 covers most of those applications — including steam resistance — with one product. It combines low print energy with fast speeds, is halogen-free, and is UL recognised and CSA approved.

tdr540.title: TDR540 Speciality Near Edge Resin | Todaytec Group Europe
tdr540.description: TDR540 is a flexible near-edge resin for industrial printers and TTO coders, with outstanding abrasion resistance at up to 12 inches per second.
tdr540.name: Speciality Near Edge Resin
tdr540.summary: A highly flexible near-edge resin for industrial printers and in-line TTO coders that need more durability than wax resin.
tdr540.body: TDR540 prints dark, dense images at up to 12 inches per second on flexible packaging films, uncoated papers and medical papers. It outperforms in abrasion resistance for parts packaging, medical devices, cosmetics, healthcare and pharmaceuticals.

wax.title: Wax Thermal Transfer Ribbons | Todaytec Group Europe
wax.description: Economical wax thermal transfer ribbons for shipping, warehouse and retail paper labels. Fast print, sharp barcodes, 400+ stock sizes, next-day despatch.
wax.headline: Economical, high-speed print where durability is not critical.
wax.intro: Wax ribbons feature high sensitivity, high density and high printability. They are typically suitable for uncoated paper and other substrates with relatively rough surfaces, delivering clear daily labelling prints at an exceptional cost-performance ratio.
wax.whyTitle: Why choose wax thermal transfer ribbons
wax.why1Body: The lowest cost per print for high-volume label production.
wax.why2Body: Crisp text, barcodes and graphics with excellent edge definition.
wax.why3Body: Perform exceptionally well at high speeds without compromising quality.
wax.why4Body: Available for virtually all flat-head printers from Zebra, Toshiba TEC, Honeywell, TSC, CAB, SATO and others.
wax.guarantee: 100% quality guarantee — or we will take it back.
wax.finderBody: Tell us what you are printing and how durable the image needs to be. If you are unsure of your printer model, it is usually on a label on the back, side or underside of the printer.

waxResin.title: Wax Resin Thermal Transfer Ribbons | Todaytec Group Europe
waxResin.description: Wax resin ribbons for labels that need more smudge and scratch resistance than wax, without the cost of a full resin. Ideal for logistics, healthcare and manufacturing.
waxResin.headline: More durability than wax, without the full resin cost.
waxResin.intro: Designed to produce sharp, reliable print on a wide range of label materials, wax resin ribbons deliver excellent barcode readability and strong resistance to rubbing, smudging and everyday handling.
waxResin.point2: Excellent resistance to scratching, smudging and rubbing
waxResin.point3: Withstand frequent handling and harsher environments
waxResin.why1Body: Enhanced resistance to scratching, smudging and abrasion for labels that are handled often.
waxResin.why2Body: Suitable for many coated paper labels and synthetic materials.
waxResin.why3Body: Consistent quality that reduces unreadable labels, reprints and line interruptions.

resin.title: Resin Thermal Transfer Ribbons | Todaytec Group Europe
resin.description: Maximum-durability resin ribbons for synthetic labels exposed to chemicals, abrasion, moisture, heat and long-term use. UL/CSA options and European stock.
resin.headline: Maximum durability for the most demanding applications.
resin.intro: Designed primarily for synthetic label materials, resin ribbons produce exceptionally sharp, permanent print with excellent resistance to abrasion, chemicals, moisture, heat and solvents.
resin.point3: The best choice for harsh environments
resin.why1Body: Hard-wearing print that resists scratching, rubbing and smudging.
resin.why2Body: Holds up against oils, cleaning agents, solvents and other chemicals.
resin.why3Body: For moisture, heat, cold, abrasion and challenging operating conditions.
resin.why4Body: Particularly suited to polyester, polypropylene and specialist label stocks.
resin.app6: Labels exposed to oil, chemicals, moisture or frequent handling

colour.title: Colour Thermal Transfer Ribbons | Todaytec Group Europe
colour.description: One of Europe’s most comprehensive colour TTR ranges. Wax, wax resin and resin colours for flat-head and near-edge printers, made to order in five days with free samples.
colour.headline: Colour thermal transfer ribbons for every printer.
colour.intro: We offer a great range of colour thermal transfer ribbons for thermal transfer printers, in-line coding printers and print-and-apply systems. Available in wax, wax resin and resin grades, for near-edge and flat-head technology. We can even produce ribbons in your own chosen colour.
colour.lead: All colour ribbons are made to order in as little as five days, with a free ribbon sample first so you can confirm suitability — or use our free testing service.
colour.infiniteBody: Made to order in only five days, in your chosen size.
colour.anyPrinterBody: Inside or outside wound, for flat-head or near-edge technology.
colour.freeBody: Receive a sample to test yourself, or we can do the testing for you.
colour.ownBody: Five days after sample confirmation. Low MOQs.

versawipes.title: Versawipes Printer Cleaning Wipes | Todaytec Group Europe
versawipes.description: Versawipes clean printheads, platen rollers and surrounding areas with a single product, prolonging printhead life and reducing label waste.
versawipes.headline: The industry’s most versatile cleaning wipe.
versawipes.intro: Great for cleaning printheads, platen rollers and surrounding areas. Versawipes clean the entire printer with just a single product.
versawipes.problemTitle: Reduce printhead replacement costs and downtime
versawipes.problemBody: The printhead is the most critical, delicate and expensive component in your printer. Most print-quality problems come from improper care. Residue from label dust, adhesive and dirt bakes onto the printhead, interferes with heat transfer, and can void manufacturer warranty if regular cleaning is not maintained.
versawipes.benefit1Body: A cleaned printhead lasts longer and provides more trouble-free printing before replacement.
versawipes.benefit2Body: Clean the printer with each ribbon change so labels print perfectly every time.
versawipes.benefit3Body: Fewer printhead replacements and no reprints from dirty heads or platen rollers.
versawipes.sachetsBody: 50 sachets per box. Minimum order: 4 boxes.
versawipes.tubBody: Great value tub, ideal next to the printer. Minimum order: 4 boxes.
versawipes.brandBody: Resellers buy own-brand sachets and add complementary wipes to each ribbon box — a simple way to differentiate the offer and bring the end user back to you. MOQs apply.

reseller.title: Become a Reseller | Todaytec Group Europe
reseller.description: Grow your label business by adding Todaytec thermal transfer ribbons. 400+ stock sizes, own-brand labelling, pricing support, free samples and full technical backup.
reseller.headline: Grow your business as a Todaytec Group Europe reseller.
reseller.intro: Finding new customers is not easy. Adding value to customers you already have is. They already know you. They already trust you. So why wouldn’t they come to you for the full solution?
reseller.sourceTitle: Be their one reliable supply source
reseller.sourceBody: Reduce admin, purchase orders, supplier management and delivery costs for your customer.
reseller.compatBody: Match the correct ribbon to the label material you supply. Better print results, fewer complaints, fewer returns.
reseller.loyaltyBody: Once a customer relies on you for labels and ribbons, they are less likely to shop around.
reseller.valueBody: Every label order is a natural opportunity to supply the matching ribbon — and ribbons are used continuously.
reseller.propBody: Offer the full solution and position your business as a partner for print quality, not just a commodity label supplier.
reseller.rangeBody: Nine Advantage qualities cover 95% of all print applications.
reseller.stockTitle: Over 400 sizes in stock for same-day shipping
reseller.stockBody: No need to hold stock of your own. Order when you need it. Box quantities apply.
reseller.specialBody: Our R&D team, with more than 50 technical patents, can create the quality, colour or size nobody else can offer.
reseller.pricingBody: Never lose ribbon sales to competition. We help you win or retain business while earning more margin.
reseller.marketingBody: Datasheets and flyers you can personalise with your own logo and contact details.
reseller.samplesBody: Your own dealer ribbon pack and free samples to send to customers.
reseller.techBody: Labels may be your main focus. Rely on us for the ribbon expertise — the repeat revenue from selling both can be substantial.
reseller.brandBody: A free-of-charge service that protects your ribbon business and your label business too.
reseller.join: Join our team of resellers across Europe

development.title: Special Ribbon Development | Todaytec Group Europe
development.description: Custom thermal transfer ribbon qualities, unique colours and specialist formulations — including two-colour and UV-activated ribbons — engineered in Europe.
development.headline: No application is impossible.
development.intro: Our Advantage range already covers 95% of print applications. When you need something special, Todaytec Group Europe can provide the ribbon for literally any print application.
development.inkBody: A team of top-tier R&D talent with more than 50 technical patents can create what you need.
development.colourBody: We can produce your chosen colour to complement your brand.
development.sizeBody: If we do not have a stock size for your equipment, we can create one.
development.fieldsBody: We already supply highly specialist sectors across Europe. Where we do not have a suitable quality today, we can develop one.
development.qtyBody: Custom products are developed to your needs, with production quantity adjusted to the required effort.
development.returnsBody: Special qualities are individually produced and excluded from returns. There are no standard price lists — contact us to discuss pricing.
development.check: Before developing a new quality, check the Advantage Range. All available from stock, covering 95% of applications.

madeToOrder.title: Made-to-Order Ribbons | Todaytec Group Europe
madeToOrder.description: Thermal transfer ribbons made to your exact width, length, core and winding. Custom labelling and packaging. Typical production 1–2 weeks.
madeToOrder.headline: Made-to-order ribbons that fit the printer and the job.
madeToOrder.intro: Not every printer or label job fits a standard ribbon size. We supply ribbons to your exact width, length, core size or winding direction — reducing waste and improving print performance.
madeToOrder.labelBody: On request we can provide a custom-designed roll and/or carton label, tailored to your specifications.
madeToOrder.qtyBody: Items are produced on demand. Please allow a quantity tolerance of ±10% for an order of approximately 100 rolls.
madeToOrder.leadBody: Standard production time is usually 1 to 2 weeks. Urgent dates can be coordinated with our order processing team.
madeToOrder.returnsBody: Custom-made rolls are produced individually and are excluded from returns.
madeToOrder.pricingBody: We calculate a net price per m², multiplied by width and length. Special cores (½” cores, plastic cores, counter cores) carry an appropriate surcharge.
madeToOrder.check: Before looking at made-to-order, check the Advantage Range — over 400 sizes in stock for next-day delivery.

testingPage.title: Ribbon Testing Service | Todaytec Group Europe
testingPage.description: Free laboratory ribbon testing in the UK and France. Send labels and current ribbon samples, or book a UK on-site engineer visit.
testingPage.headline: Not sure which ribbon you need? We will test it.
testingPage.intro: With fully equipped testing facilities in the UK and France, we can identify the right ribbon for your application.
testingPage.step1: Send us 5 metres of the labels or substrate you will print onto.
testingPage.step2: Send a sample label printed with your current ribbon.
testingPage.step3: If comparing against another supplier, include a sample of that ribbon where possible.
testingPage.labBody: We complete the testing, supply printed samples to review, and a sample ribbon if requested so you can see the results yourself.
testingPage.siteBody: Book an engineer to test at your customer’s site. They will use optimum printer settings and may advise on size or grade changes to improve performance and cost. You receive a full post-visit report covering grades, durability and barcode scan results.
testingPage.fee: A call-out charge of £500 applies initially and is credited back after the first £500 of ribbon orders for that site.
testingPage.formLead: Complete the form and we will send a test reference number. Mark it clearly on the package you send us.

branding.title: Custom Branding | Todaytec Group Europe
branding.description: Free-of-charge private label box-end labels and datasheets for thermal transfer ribbon resellers. Protect your ribbon and label business.
branding.headline: How do you protect your ribbon business?
branding.intro: A free-of-charge service: Todaytec Group Europe can provide custom-branded box labels and datasheets for you to send to your customers.
branding.point1: No need to produce these yourself — saving time and money.
branding.point2: Your unique grades, part numbers and branding make it harder for customers to shop around.
branding.point3: Harder for competitors to take your ribbon business.
branding.boxBody: Design your custom-branded box-end label with your company logo and details.
branding.dataBody: Build a complete datasheet range in your own brand.
branding.noMoq: No minimum order quantity. Free of charge.

trx.title: Todaytec Ribbon Exchange (TRX) | Todaytec Group Europe
trx.description: Win competitor ribbon business with price support, advance testing, sale-or-return and on-site conversion support from Todaytec Group Europe.
trx.headline: Win more ribbon business.
trx.intro: The Todaytec Ribbon Exchange programme gives resellers the tools to swap out competitor product and grow ribbon sales alongside labels.
trx.win: Win more — turn competitor ribbon spend into new business.
trx.earn: Earn more — competitive price support to boost your margin.
trx.retain: Retain more — a proven alternative that strengthens the relationship.
trx.risk: Reduce the risk — advance testing and sale-or-return.
trx.support: Get full support — from product selection to customer site visits.
trx.repeat: Build repeat revenue — especially with free custom branding.
trx.range: 95% of applications covered in one compact range. 400+ ribbons in stock. OEM quality or better. Compatible ribbons do not damage printheads and do not automatically void printer warranties.
trx.priceBody: Got a competitor price to beat? Bring us the opportunity. We will help you compete for it.
trx.testBody: We identify the right Todaytec ribbon before they switch, so the transition is smooth and reliable.
trx.sorBody: Customers try ribbons in their own production environment. If they do not perform as expected, they return them for a full refund.
trx.siteBody: Our team can support the conversion with customer site visits. You do not have to win competitor business alone.
trx.cta: Got an opportunity we can help with?

europe.title: Todaytec Group Europe | Local Expertise. European Strength.
europe.description: REGMA, Calor and Thermal Transfer Solutions — Todaytec Group Europe combines coating, converting and local service across France, Germany, the UK and the Netherlands.
europe.headline: Local expertise. European strength. Global manufacturing.
europe.intro: Welcome to Todaytec Group Europe, our network of European thermal transfer ribbon coating and converting operations: REGMA in France, Calor in Germany, Thermal Transfer Solutions Ltd in the UK and Thermal Transfer Solutions BV in the Netherlands.
europe.merger: This group brings together decades of industry expertise, technical excellence and a shared commitment to become the number-one thermal transfer ribbon supplier in the world. Customers across Europe now access a broader and more advanced product portfolio, backed by the trusted service of TTS, Calor and REGMA.
europe.capacity: Our current European set-up includes 10 converting lines and 3 coating machines, with capacity to supply more than 200,000,000 square metres of thermal transfer ribbons. Made in Europe.
europe.global: Todaytec Group Europe is part of the Todaytec Group, a globally recognised leader with state-of-the-art production in Asia and a distribution network spanning over 80 countries. With an annual coating capacity of over 2,000,000,000 square metres, we combine cutting-edge products and consistent supply with localised European support.
europe.t1986Body: Rhône-Poulenc began coating thermal-transfer films and producing ribbons in Arques-la-Bataille, Normandy.
europe.t1991Body: Founded as a family business with a single cutting machine at ITS Baesweiler.
europe.t2002Body: Hangzhou Todaytec Digital Technology Co., Ltd. is established in Hangzhou, China. Calor also acquires REGMA this year.
europe.t2006Body: One slitting machine in the corner of a factory, with a plan to become a major TTR supplier.
europe.t2016: Thermal Transfer Solutions BV is established
europe.t2016Body: Hoorn / Zwaag, the Netherlands — expanding stockholding and next-day delivery for the Netherlands, Belgium and nearby markets. Todaytec acquired TTS the same year.
europe.t2024Body: A move to further expand European operations.
europe.t2025Body: TTS, Calor and REGMA join forces, with one shared commitment to become Europe’s largest ribbon supplier.

global.title: Todaytec Global | Proven Ribbon Quality. Trusted Supply.
global.description: Todaytec is one of the world’s leading thermal transfer ribbon manufacturers: #4 global market share, #2 global production, 2 billion sqm coating capacity, 15 overseas subsidiaries.
global.headline: Proven ribbon quality. Trusted supply.
global.trusted: Trusted by distributors, converters, resellers and end users across the world.
global.intro: TodayTec manufactures premium thermal transfer ribbons engineered for exceptional print quality, durability and consistency — from retail and logistics to healthcare, manufacturing and packaging.
global.apart2: Global supply capabilities with dependable delivery
global.apart3: Localised service teams for responsive customer support
global.qcBody: End-to-end monitoring from raw material inspection to final product. High-speed cameras check each coated surface for even the smallest defects.
global.ecoBody: A closed-loop system with equipment from the USA recycles exhaust gases during production for power generation.
global.batchBody: China’s first unmanned ink workshop precisely controls error rates and ensures consistent quality across batches.
global.fsc: All ribbon cores come from sustainably managed forests and are FSC certified.
global.waste: 100% of film waste is collected during production and used to generate electricity.
global.solar: Almost 10% of electricity consumption is generated from solar panels — equivalent to 88.5 tonnes less coal and about 260 tonnes less CO₂ each year, and increasing.
global.t2009: First overseas company in the USA
global.t2015: Zhejiang Tianhao Digital Technology Co Ltd established (listed on Shenzhen ChiNext in 2018)
global.rdTitle: Research and development is at the core of what we do
global.rdBody: A team of top-tier R&D talent from around the world, with more than 50 technical patents. If you have an application with no ready-made solution, put us to the test.
global.outside: For enquiries outside Europe, contact Todaytec Global.

tts.title: Thermal Transfer Solutions (TTS) | Todaytec Group Europe
tts.description: TTS is Europe’s leading TTR converter, established in 2006. Advantage Range, 400 stock sizes, trade-only policy, UK and Netherlands operations.
tts.headline: Mighty oaks from little acorns grow.
tts.intro: It started with one slitting machine in the corner of a factory in 2006 and a plan to become a major thermal transfer ribbon supplier. Exclusive UK slitting agreements with DNP and Ricoh quickly expanded the operation to three machines.
tts.model: Our unique model — the Advantage Range of compact grades with maximum performance, plus 400 stock sizes for same-day shipping — helps resellers grow sales substantially. A trade-only policy has built long-lasting relationships across the UK and Europe.
tts.leadBody: Converting jumbo rolls to stock ribbons using state-of-the-art equipment.
tts.custom: Custom-size ribbons when you need them
tts.customBody: Making stock to order in as little as five days.
tts.ukBody: 50% of orders shipped with the reseller’s own brand — still with same-day shipping.
tts.t2006: TTS Limited established with a single slitting machine.
tts.t2008: Moves into its own facility in Nash Road, Redditch.
tts.t2016: TTS BV established in Zwaag to support the Netherlands, Belgium and surrounding markets.
tts.t2019: Move to a 12,000 sq ft facility in Eagle Road, Redditch.
tts.t2021a: TTS UK and BV join Todaytec Group.
tts.t2021b: TTS BV moves to larger premises in Zwaag.
tts.t2025: Todaytec Group Europe is formed with Calor and REGMA.
tts.mission: Working with label resellers, our mission has always been to add value to their label sales by offering thermal transfer ribbon too — protecting existing label business as well as growing it.
tts.factory: Exciting changes are on the way: our UK factory has been chosen for a £3.5 million smart factory investment.
tts.wipes: Have you tried the UK’s most versatile printer cleaning wipe? One product for printheads, platen rollers, label sensors and surrounding areas.

calor.title: Calor | Todaytec Group Europe
calor.description: Calor GmbH in Baesweiler, Germany — thermal transfer ribbon converting since 1991, ISO 9001, partnered with REGMA coating in France, now part of Todaytec Group Europe.
calor.headline: A family business, grown into a European TTR specialist.
calor.intro: Founded in 1991 with a single cutting machine at ITS Baesweiler, Calor began as a supplier of thermal transfer solutions. Hard work and passion have been at the core of everything we do from the beginning. Long-term, trust-based customer relationships, personal exchange and reliable service remain our priority.
calor.group: Membership of Todaytec Group Europe, which began in February 2025, marks an exciting new chapter.
calor.converterBody: In close collaboration with REGMA in France we develop ribbon qualities tailored to your requirements, including colour, chemistry and structure.
calor.coaterBody: In France we coat jumbo rolls using hot-melt and solvent-based processes on three high-performance coating systems.
calor.developerBody: State-of-the-art laboratories and years of experience fulfil demanding customer requests.
calor.allroundBody: At facilities in Normandy and Baesweiler, a team of 50 specialists produces around 5,000 thermal transfer ribbons daily, processing about 150,000 m² of foil with three coating and seven cutting machines.
calor.t1998: Relocation to a purpose-designed site in Baesweiler — still our home today.
calor.t2002: Calor acquires REGMA for coating, testing and development in France.
calor.t2007: First DIN EN ISO 9001:2000 certification in thermal transfer.
calor.t2012: First two-colour ribbons developed, coated and produced at REGMA.
calor.t2021: 30-year anniversary of Calor and 20 years of REGMA, celebrated in Normandy.
calor.t2025: Todaytec Group Europe is formed; debut as a European group at Labelexpo Barcelona.

regma.title: REGMA | Todaytec Group Europe
regma.description: REGMA in Arques-la-Bataille, France — thermal transfer ribbon coating since 1986. Specialist colours, two-colour ribbons, UV grades and European manufacturing.
regma.headline: Crafted in France. Proven in performance.
regma.intro: Established in 1986 in Arques-la-Bataille, REGMA combines technical expertise, advanced coating capabilities and a strong understanding of thermal transfer printing.
regma.cover: Our expertise covers development, coating and conversion of thermal transfer ribbons — from dependable standard products to specialist colours, custom sizes and application-specific formulations.
regma.group: As part of Todaytec Group Europe, REGMA brings established European manufacturing knowledge together with the wider resources of the Todaytec Group.
regma.s1: Specialist knowledge of thermal transfer ribbon technology
regma.s3: Wax, wax-resin, resin, colour and specialist ribbon solutions
regma.s6: Reliable quality and responsive technical support
regma.goal: Our goal is simple: the right ribbon, consistent performance and dependable support for every application.
regma.t1986: Rhône-Poulenc began coating thermal-transfer films under licence from Dai Nippon Printing — the start of the site’s long-standing expertise.
regma.t2002: Calor acquires REGMA. The two companies work closely across development, coating, converting and sales.
regma.t2012: First two-colour ribbons produced — two colours in one ribbon, reducing changeovers.
regma.t2017: First UV light-activated ribbons produced for a specific customer application.
regma.t2025: REGMA and Calor join Todaytec Group Europe, later operating with TTS under one identity.

news.title: News | Todaytec Group Europe
news.description: Todaytec Group announces a £3.5 million investment in a UK smart factory at Thermal Transfer Solutions in Redditch.
news.headline: Latest from Todaytec Group Europe
news.articleTitle: Todaytec Group announces £3.5 million investment in a UK smart factory
news.articleBody1: Thermal Transfer Solutions Ltd is delighted to announce that Todaytec Group has selected the United Kingdom as the location for a major new smart factory investment.
news.articleBody2: Following a review of several potential locations across Europe, the UK was chosen from a shortlist of five other countries as the preferred site for this £3.5 million project. The investment demonstrates a strong commitment to the UK market, our customers, and continued growth.
news.articleBody3: The new smart factory will help strengthen supply-chain security, support future innovation, and ensure Thermal Transfer Solutions is well positioned to continue delivering the service, quality and reliability customers expect.
news.articleBody4: Thermal Transfer Solutions is a proud member of Todaytec Group Europe — converting and coating locations across France, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with combined sales in excess of £20,000,000.
news.articleBody5: We look forward to sharing further updates as the project progresses.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Todaytec Group Europe
privacy.description: Privacy policy for todaytecgroupeurope.com — how Todaytec Group Europe collects, uses and retains personal data.
privacy.headline: Privacy policy
privacy.whoBody: Our website address is https://todaytecgroupeurope.com. Todaytec Group Europe is the European coating and converting network of the Todaytec Group, with operations in the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Germany and France.
privacy.collectBody: When you submit an enquiry, sample request, testing request or reseller form we collect the details you provide (such as name, company, email, telephone, country and message) so we can respond. If you contact us by email or telephone, we will use those details to handle your request.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to answer enquiries, despatch samples, carry out ribbon testing, support reseller applications and, where relevant, to fulfil orders. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.shareBody: Your enquiry may be shared with the appropriate Todaytec Group Europe company (Thermal Transfer Solutions Ltd, Thermal Transfer Solutions BV, Calor or REGMA) so the local team can help you. Hosting and email providers may process data on our behalf.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, or ask us to correct or erase it, except where we must keep it for legal, administrative or security reasons. Contact the office that handles your account, or email sales@tts.eu.com.
privacy.retainBody: Enquiry records are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and for a reasonable business period afterwards. You can ask us to delete them sooner where the law allows.
